title: Sync
offlineTooltip: No internet connection — this action is unavailable
pushDescription: Sends queued offline changes (created transactions, payments, refunds) to the server in the order they were created.
confirmRemoveQueueItem: Remove this item from the queue? It will not be sent to the server.
syncListDescription: Downloads every page of the list from the server and saves it for offline viewing, including switching between pages.
syncDetailsDescription: Downloads the full detail page for every record in the list so it can be opened without internet.
syncDetailsRequiresList: Update the list first — records are downloaded from it.
